Subject: Privacy Annex / Data Agreement — initial redlines

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

Attached is our first pass at the Privacy Annex / DPA (DPA_Redline_Fintrix_v1.docx). High-level items we’d like to discuss:

- Data transfers: Fintrix requires explicit reference to the EU SCCs (2021) and confirmation Redwood has completed a Transfer Impact Assessment.
- Subprocessors: please share the current subprocessor list and confirm at least 30 days notice before onboarding any new subprocessors (except emergency operational changes).
- Audit & compliance: Fintrix prefers a right to audit for security controls; if Redwood cannot provide on-site audits, we need confirmation that SOC 2 Type II reports and a customer portal for logs satisfy the requirement.
- Data retention & deletion: we’ve redlined customer data deletion to 30 days post-termination; please confirm you can comply.

We’re happy to do a short call next week to walk through material redlines, then move to eSign. Procurement copied for timing.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Santos

Elena —

Thanks for the thoughtful redlines. I’ve reviewed and attached a marked-up PDF with counsel comments (Counsel_comments_Fintrix_DPA_v2.pdf). Key positions from our side:

1) Data transfers / SCCs
- Confirmed: Redwood will incorporate the EU Commission SCCs (2021) where applicable and provide our Transfer Impact Assessment summary. We cannot agree to blanket language that implies we assume regulatory risk for host-country law; suggested compromise language added.

2) Subprocessors & notice
- We will provide the current subprocessor list and proactive notice of planned additions. We propose a 30-day notice for non-critical new subprocessors; for emergency operational changes (e.g., failover or patching) we will notify "as soon as practicable" with post-hoc confirmation.

3) Audit rights
- We cannot provide unrestricted onsite audits. We accept SOC 2 Type II + annual penetration test reports and will provide a compliance portal snapshot on request. We added a clause to allow a mutually agreed third-party review under NDA in exceptional circumstances.

4) Data deletion / retention
- Our standard deletion window after contract termination is 60 days to allow for backup cycle completion and legal holds. We propose 60 days; we can negotiate shorter timelines for specific datasets that are not subject to backups/log retention.

5) Security controls
- We will confirm encryption in transit and at rest, KMS options for enterprise customers, and any region-specific key residency options in the Private deployment offering sections.

We tried to be pragmatic where possible. If Fintrix can accept the compromise language on transfers and deletion (60 days), we can produce a signature-ready PDF and route via DocuSign.

Available for a call Tue 10 Nov 09:00–11:00 PT.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference
